say:4:1510306004:0.text: These creatures have been on the move lately. I call them <style="highlight">needle locusts</style>.
say:4:1510306004:0.source_cn: 这些是近来频频异动的怪物，我称其为<style=hig...

say:5:1510306005:0.text: They're harbingers of barren doom. They don't just devour crops. They strip the land bare, leaving nothing but dead soil behind. Where they swarm, nothing grows again.
say:5:1510306005:0.source_cn: 针蝗可谓是荒芜的化身，它们不仅啃噬作物和庄稼，连草木都...

say:7:1510306007:0.text: Wherever you find Halians, you'll find these needle locusts wreaking havoc.
say:7:1510306007:0.source_cn: 呼临人在何处生活，针蝗便在何处肆虐。

say:8:1510306008:0.text: They follow the humans like a shadowy plague.
say:8:1510306008:0.source_cn: 随着呼临人迁徙到这里，它们也阴魂不散地尾随而来了。

say:9:1510306009:0.text:
Strange omen...
They seem to be a curse from the gods.
say:9:1510306009:0.source_cn: 奇怪的习性……\n它们，仿佛是神明降下的诅咒。

say:10:1510306010:0.text: Your emissary is quite perceptive, Herdmaster. The truth might not be far from her guess...
say:10:1510306010:0.source_cn: 神啊，您的使徒真是敏锐。说不定，真相和她的猜测差不多呢。
say:10:1510306010:0.male: Your emissary is quite perceptive, Herdmaster. The truth might not be far from her guess...
say:10:1510306010:0.female: Your emissary is quite perceptive, Herdmaster. The truth might not be far from her guess...

say:12:1510306012:0.text: If the humans are cursed, who is at fault?
say:12:1510306012:0.source_cn: 人类被诅咒，那么，过错是？

say:13:1510306013:0.text: To bear a divine curse without cause, to suffer at the whim of a callous god. Such cruelty begs retribution, does it not? What judgment should await a god so merciless?
say:13:1510306013:0.source_cn: 假如根本没有过错，却平白无故地遭到神明诅咒，这等残忍任...

choice_prompt:14:1510306013.text: To bear a divine curse without cause, to suffer at the whim of a callous god. Such cruelty begs retribution, does it not? What judgment should await a god so merciless?
choice_prompt:14:1510306013.source_cn: 假如根本没有过错，却平白无故地遭到神明诅咒，这等残忍任性的神明，又该面对怎样的结局？

say:15:1510306014:0.source_cn: 您的神谕让我充满希望。

say:17:1510306017:0.text: Very well, let's keep moving. I wonder if we'll encounter other monsters along the way.
say:17:1510306017:0.source_cn: 好了，继续赶路吧。不知道会不会出现其他怪物。

say:18:1510306018:0.text: But I'm sure we can handle whatever comes at us.
say:18:1510306018:0.source_cn: 不过，有神明守候在旁，也没什么可担心的。
say:18:1510306018:0.male: But I'm sure we can handle whatever comes at us.
say:18:1510306018:0.female: But I'm sure we can handle whatever comes at us.

say:20:1510306015:0.source_cn: 多么令人安心的神谕啊。

choice:14:1:2.text: He'll be defeated sooner or later.
choice:14:1:2.male: He'll be defeated sooner or later.
choice:14:1:2.female: He'll be defeated sooner or later.

say:21:1510306002:0.text: What is bug spray? Where can I find some?
say:21:1510306002:0.source_cn: 杀虫剂……加拉该去哪里找到它？
say:21:1510306002:0.male: What is bug spray? Where can I find some?
say:21:1510306002:0.female: What is bug spray? Where can I find some?

say:22:1510306003:0.text: Even if we had such a thing, I'm afraid we wouldn't be able to defeat all of them.
say:22:1510306003:0.source_cn: 就算有了这种东西，恐怕也无法打败它们。
